verdict.rationale: Gazebo documents official C++ libraries that developers build against directly: gz-math, sdformat, gz-transport, a C++ Fuel client library, and gz-sim itself used as a library in standalone programs and custom plugins. These span math, transport, physics, GUI and simulation, so the C++ surface is broad. However, there is no evidence of official SDKs in Python, TypeScript or Go, which is the multi-language core of the story. Missing for 10: official Python, TypeScript and Go SDKs; evidence that the SDKs cover the full platform surface; independent corroboration of SDK typing and quality.
